messages.content: The Higgins confirmation came through, but the header says two adults. Farther down it says three occupants and two queen beds. Is our daughter actually on the reservation without another charge?
Yes. The guest detail lists two adults and one child, age 14, for three total occupants in a two-queen room. The header only counts adults; there is no added occupancy charge for her.
Good. The first-night deposit has posted. Also, the portal just says cancel by October 7, while the email says 6:00 p.m. Central that day. Which deadline controls?

The email supplies the time omitted by the portal: cancellation must be completed by 6:00 p.m. Central on October 7. The posted first-night deposit is refundable to the original payment method if cancellation is made before that cutoff.
So we have three guests, two queens, no extra occupancy fee, and the deposit is protected through that deadline?
Correct. Keep the confirmation email with the reservation record because it states the operative cutoff. The room and deposit details are otherwise settled.
